listings.remarks: Looking for a new home? This beautiful residence with a POOL in the desirable Palm Valley is the one! Offering 3 beds + den, 2 baths, mature landscape, and a 2.5-car garage w/cabinetry. Discover inviting living spaces, perfect for everyday living & entertaining! The eat-in kitchen boasts built-in appliances w/gas range, a pantry, ample cabinetry, and an island w/breakfast bar. The versatile den is perfect for an office! The large primary bedroom has a walk-in closet and an ensuite with dual sinks & separate tub/shower. When it's time to unwind, the backyard oasis awaits you with a covered patio, lush lawn, and a refreshing pool for year-round enjoyment. Don't miss this opportunity!

features.Kitchen: Kitchen island with breakfast bar, pantry, gas range, built-in microwave, dishwasher, refrigerator
features.Primary suite: Walk-in closet, dual sinks, separate tub and shower

schools: Agua Fria Union High School District
